findings.current: The monsters swept around them with speed that belied their enormous frames. Beyond them, the black-robed man spoke through clenched teeth to the intruder, blocked from view by a wall of monsters.
findings.defect: The draft places the wall of monsters in front of the intruder rather than in front of the black-robed man.
findings.rationale: 철벽처럼 앞을 가로막은 괴물들 너머로 흑의인은 places the speaker behind the monsters blocking the way.
findings.replacement: The monsters swept around them with speed that belied their enormous frames, forming an impenetrable wall in front of the black-robed man. From behind it, he spoke through clenched teeth.
findings.source: 그 거대한 체격과는 어울리지 않는 속도로 삽시간에 주위를 에워싸는 한편, 철벽처럼 앞을 가로막은 괴물들 너머로 흑의인은 씹어뱉듯 말을 이었다.

findings.current: The intruder rambled on, then clapped a hand over his mouth.
findings.defect: The draft adds a hand gesture; he abruptly closes his mouth.
findings.rationale: 입을 다물었다 describes closing his mouth, with no hand action.
findings.replacement: The intruder stopped rambling and snapped his mouth shut with a little gasp.
findings.source: 주절주절 떠들던 불청객이 헙, 하고 입을 다물었다.

findings.current: The intruder, surrounded by horrible monsters, had perked up his ears and cupped his hands around his mouth like a trumpet to listen.
findings.defect: Cupping his hands around his mouth would project his voice, not help him hear; the action is directed at listening.
findings.rationale: 두 손으로 나팔 모양까지 만들어 주위의 소리를 듣고 있던 ties the hand gesture to hearing the sounds around him.
findings.replacement: The intruder, surrounded by horrible monsters, had perked up his ears and even cupped his hands around them like a trumpet to listen.
findings.source: 귀를 쫑긋 세운 채, 두 손으로 나팔 모양까지 만들어 주위의 소리를 듣고 있던 불청객을 향해.

findings.current: He had neither the internal energy of several jiazi nor martial arts exceptional enough to be called divine.
findings.defect: “Several” invents a quantity absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 갑자 단위 means measured in units of jiazi; it does not specify several.
findings.replacement: He had neither internal energy measured in jiazi nor martial arts exceptional enough to be called divine.
findings.source: 갑자 단위의 공력도, 신공(神功)이라 불릴 정도로 뛰어난 무공도 없지만

findings.current: “You… You’re a spy for the orthodox faction.”
findings.defect: “Spy” assigns a specific role where the accusation is that he is a lackey or agent.
findings.rationale: 끄나풀 marks a subordinate doing another group’s bidding, not necessarily an intelligence operative.

findings.current: Each of the monsters guarding him had skill comparable to a martial artist of at least First Rate, and some were as strong as Peak masters.
findings.defect: The lower bound drops from Supreme First Rate to First Rate.
findings.rationale: 초일류 is the established Supreme First Rate realm.
findings.replacement: Each monster guarding him had skill comparable to a master ranging from at least Supreme First Rate up to Peak.
findings.source: 그를 호위하는 괴물들은 저마다 최소 초일류에서 절정의 고수들과 비견될 정도의 실력을 지녔다.

findings.current: “That’s a relief. Just like Little Grandpa.”
findings.defect: The draft loses the intruder’s confidence that Little Grandpa is responsible for the missing replies.
findings.rationale: 역시 expresses vindicated confidence in him, following the discovery that no bells answer.
findings.replacement: “What a relief. I knew I could count on Little Grandpa.”

findings.current: More precisely, he had no awareness left with which to answer.
findings.defect: “No awareness” suggests impaired consciousness rather than being too overwhelmed to respond.
findings.rationale: 대답할 정신조차 남아 있지 않았다 concerns his mental composure; he remains conscious and asks a question immediately afterward.
findings.replacement: More precisely, he no longer had the presence of mind to answer.
findings.source: 보다 정확히는, 대답할 정신조차 남아 있지 않았다.

findings.current: The body crumpled helplessly as the Sleep Acupoint was struck.
findings.defect: The acupoint is pressed, not struck.
findings.rationale: 눌림 specifies pressure on the acupoint.
findings.replacement: His body crumpled helplessly as the Sleep Acupoint was pressed.
findings.source: 수혈(睡血)이 눌림과 동시에 힘없이 허물어지는 몸뚱어리.

summary: Action reversals and several meaningful terminology and characterization errors.
